sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a third every two bars.

Episode 4

sections.leads: From G major to A minor

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every two bars. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Tenor: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Bass: the opening of the subject and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From A minor to G major

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a fifth every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Returns in Episode 7 (bars 82–83).
sections.leads: From G major to C major

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 6 (bars 77–78) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the tenor's line in the bass, the bass's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From C major to F major

sections.label: Episode 8

sections.leads: From F major to D minor

sections.leads: From D minor to C major

sections.label: Episode 10
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar.
